channel.title: Planet Of The Apes
channel.desc: Action 2001 After a space mission goes awry, astronaut Leo Davidson crash-lands on a mysterious planet ruled by intelligent apes, and humans are enslaved. With the help of rebels, Leo leads a revolt against the beasts and uncovers shocking truths about humanity's past. Mark Wahlberg, Helena Bonham Carter, Tim Roth, Michael Clarke Duncan, Estella Warren , Tim Burton, Pierre Boulle.
